title: Control Inventory
surface: One exercise per agent verb: a checkbox and radios (one radio group replaced by its summary once picked), a long press and a double click told apart from a tap, a context menu that opens on right-click only, a file input, the browser Back button, and a footnote that must be scrolled into view.
task: Agree to the terms, pick Medium size and Express delivery, long-press Hold me, double-click Double-click me, rename report.pdf to summary.pdf from its right-click menu, attach a file, open the details and go back with the browser, and scroll the footnote into view.
